title: Make Free AI Presenter Videos in Google Vids
description:
Comment "AVATAR" and I'll send you the link 👇

Google just made AI presenter videos free in Google Vids. Go to vids.new, upload a Google Slides deck, and it becomes a video with a digital presenter reading your script. Pick from 53 avatars or build your own with Nano Banana 2. They now speak 24 languages, so one avatar pitches in English today, Arabic tomorrow. Free tier, 10 generations a month. US first, global this summer.

#ai #google #videocreation #aitools
